name: Cold Sleep
source:
There is a famous thief group, Cureflone. The members are White Flone and Black Flone and they fly around the town in search of a precious stone called Pure Stone every night. Shoutaro is a private detective and he tries to catch them using a robot he invented. Also, Dr. Chan takes part in a battle for the Pure Stone.... An exciting three way fight now breaks out!

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/09/vn-of-month-september-2008-sumaga.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
有一个著名的盗贼组织Cureflone。成员是White Flone和Black Flone，他们每天晚上在城镇里飞来飞去寻找一种叫做Pure Stone的宝石。翔太郎是一名私家侦探，他试图用自己发明的机器人抓住他们。此外，陈博士还参加了一场纯石之战……一场激动人心的三人大战即将爆发！

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/09/vn-of-month-september-2008-sumaga.html]vndbreview[/url]]
